Stop before completion to keep them. Once released, water takes three more minutes to reach the launch through the inlet. Deniz must have repaired the inlet and be holding it open when the water arrives.Stopping repair keeps every paid minute and the installed fitting. Available time lets you recover automatically; eating uses your owned portion only after two paid minutes.

Water across the cutValve · youInletLaunch6 min walk5 min cartYou and Deniz serve the same two-unit launch. You own two units at the valve; Deniz owns one cart unit. Pipe water needs both repaired stations and Deniz attending the inlet. The cart reaches the launch after five minutes and then takes five minutes back.Inspect to learn your local repair. The launch notice is at the inlet. A delivery at its departure minute still counts.How Deniz choosesDeniz inspects the inlet, spends one minute reporting its repair and launch facts, then repairs and holds the inlet while pipe service remains possible. If the remaining repair or a received upstream fact proves the pipe route too late, Deniz uses the cart when it can still arrive. A missing report alone never proves failure. Every repair, message, cart trip and minute attending is paid. Available time recovers strength.Time and radioA radio report costs one charge and one paid minute, then takes 2–6 minutes to arrive. It is not lost under this channel’s stated rules. Both people may receive while working.Continue advances to your next useful local event. A received report stops time for your decision while leaving any unfinished job underway. Stop work explicitly if you change your mind. Reading tabs never advances the shift.Your shift lasts 30 minutes even if the launch leaves earlier. An unheard event at the other station cannot end your account.Your accountMinute 6 of 30. Work, capacity, body estimates, information access and Deniz’s policy are software rules, not calibrated measurements of people. There is no LLM, moral-worth score or religious evaluator. Radio reception is automatic; it is not an attention or memory model.Save files contain the complete shift recipe, including starting conditions. Ordinary play shows only your character’s information. Downloads can reveal facts that have not yet reached your character.
